required_manual_checks.description: Inspect the existing 2G.1 manifest, gate scripts, recovery wrapper and Coordinator gate interface. Choose and document the smallest deterministic non-secret evidence mechanism (ephemeral orchestration, local Git/operator state, generated artifact, or recomputation). A PROVEN claim must identify suite, legitimate phase, execution/run, actual pass result, environment class and code/test identity; changed tested inputs invalidate old evidence. If a Coordinator core or gate-registry change is required, stop and propose a separate Coordinator task rather than editing tools/agent/**.

Run focused architecture tests that reject: required variables present without execution; a skipped suite; static proof presented as db/server/recovery proof; db proof presented for another phase; stale evidence after a test or tested-code change; and malformed or tampered evidence. Show that a real db pass satisfies only applicable db suites and all legitimate phase passes satisfy the aggregate. The tests must prove secrets are absent from serialized evidence.

Demonstrate that a successful recovery proof is accepted only when its test process has database URLs absent; a recovery proof process with any *DATABASE_URL* visible still refuses, and its network guard remains intact. The wrapper must keep stripping inherited database URLs. Production/database proof processes receive no recovery secrets. Use fixture evidence only; do not use production credentials or contact production for this task's tests.

Preserve gate:static, gate:db, gate:server and the recovery verification flow where practical. A static-only invocation must never claim db/server/recovery execution. The aggregate check must fail closed without valid phase evidence, with no 2A.2d special case or hardcoded permitted-red exception. Document the exact operator commands and how the existing Coordinator gate command verifies the aggregate; if that cannot be achieved inside the listed paths, stop for a separate task.

Diff is confined to the seven exact write paths. No Sales or 2A.2d implementation, schema/migration, RLS/grants, production configuration, deploy, or Coordinator core changes. Historical one-red closure records remain identifiable; the new contract clearly supersedes their use for future freezes.
